description: Every SolarEdge Monitoring API endpoint, plus local history that answers questions the API itself can't.

novel_features.name: System health check
novel_features.description: See one combined go/no-go status for a site instead of cross-referencing several separate calls.

novel_features.name: Underperformance vs baseline
novel_features.description: Flag days where production fell below this site's own historical average for that time of year.

novel_features.name: What changed since X
novel_features.description: Get a short digest of the energy delta vs the prior period of equal length, plus a current equipment-count snapshot.

novel_features.name: Rate-limit budget tracker
novel_features.description: See how much of today's 300-request quota this CLI has used, per site.

novel_features.name: Equipment fault digest
novel_features.description: See only the inverters, batteries, or system elements in a non-nominal state.
